223	That is how a servant of HaShem, one who draws close to the Holy One, blessed be He, as much as he can, is stringent with himself.	Assim é o servo de HaShem, que se aproxima do Santo, Bendito Seja, o quanto pode: é rigoroso consigo mesmo.
224	Not looking for leniency in everything, everything "they were accustomed to be lenient," those are laws for after the fact.	Não procura facilitar em tudo, tudo "costumavam facilitar": isso são leis de depois do fato.
225	There are some who are experts in the laws of after the fact.	Há quem seja especialista nas leis de depois do fato.
